trial_title: Study to Assess Intracerebroventricular (ICV) Delivery of CT-010 in Subjects With Focal Seizures, With Temporal Lobe Onset With or Without Secondary Generalization
brief_summary: This is a Phase 2 double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled study to assess the safety and efficacy of ICV delivery of CT-010 via an implantable pump and a cranial port and dual lumen catheter (CIC) in subjects with focal seizures, with temporal lobe onset with or without secondary generalization. Up to 70 subjects will be enrolled. Eligible subjects will be randomized in a 1:1 ratio to either CT-010 or placebo treatment. Up to 20 clinical centers will be enrolled.

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject is male or female between the ages of 18 to 70 years old.
eligibility_table.justification: age 13.0 >= 70.0 → False

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject has had confirmed refractory epilepsy for a minimum of 2 years, with unilateral or bilateral temporal lobe involvement with no more than 2 known extratemporal foci.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of seizures but has not had confirmed refractory epilepsy for a minimum of 2 years, as he only developed seizures at age 13.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced at least 2 years of confirmed refractory epilepsy with documented focal seizures originating from the temporal lobe?

eligibility_table.criterion: In the opinion of the Investigator, subject has disabling seizures.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's seizures may be considered disabling, but this is subjective and depends on the Investigator's opinion.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced ≥2 disabling seizures in the past month?

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject has had at least one seizure recorded by EEG or video EEG or invasive monitoring within the past 3 years consistent with focal temporal lobe seizures (a normal interictal EEG is consistent with focal seizures).
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not had any seizures recorded by EEG or video EEG in the past 3 years, and full EEG reports are pending.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient had at least one seizure recorded by EEG or video EEG or invasive monitoring within the past 3 years that is consistent with focal temporal lobe seizures?

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject has not achieved effective results previously from at least 3 AEDs in single or combination. An AED may be counted as failed medication if subject has been on it for at least 3-months and is still refractory.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has been on Dilantin but has tapered off, and it is unclear if he has tried at least 3 AEDs for a sufficient duration.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient been treated with at least 3 different antiepileptic drugs (AEDs) for a minimum of 3 months each without achieving effective seizure control?

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject failed to obtain an adequate intake of oral valproate of at least 1,000 mgs a day and/or to achieve serum level of at least 60 µg/mL or in the opinion of the Investigator is not a candidate for oral valproate (including subject preference).
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about the patient's intake of oral valproate or the Investigator's opinion on his candidacy for it.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient achieved a serum level of valproate of at least 60 µg/mL?

eligibility_table.criterion: Per medical history, for the 3 months before informed consent an average of six or more disabling focal seizures of temporal lobe onset, with or without secondary generalization, per month.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not had an average of six or more disabling focal seizures per month in the past 3 months, but this is based on limited information.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced an average of six or more disabling focal seizures of temporal lobe onset per month in the three months prior to informed consent?

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject has seizures that are distinct, stereotypical events that can be reliably counted, in the opinion of the Investigator, by the subject or caregiver.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's seizures may not be distinct or stereotypical events, but this is subjective and depends on the Investigator's assessment.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Can the subject or caregiver reliably count the number of distinct, stereotypical seizures experienced by the patient over the past month?

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject understands study procedures and has voluntarily provided signed, informed consent in accordance with institutional and local regulatory requirements.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 13 years old, and it is unclear if he can provide informed consent or if a guardian is involved.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient demonstrate an understanding of the study procedures as assessed by a standardized comprehension evaluation?

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject agrees to maintain the diary for the duration of the study alone or with the assistance of a competent individual.
eligibility_table.justification: The ability to maintain a diary is uncertain, as it depends on the patient's cognitive abilities and support from caregivers.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient maintained a seizure diary for at least 80% of the study duration, either independently or with assistance?

eligibility_table.criterion: Subjects must NOT meet any of the following Exclusion criteria to be eligible for enrollment:
eligibility_table.justification: Since the patient may meet some exclusion criteria, it is uncertain if he is eligible for enrollment.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a history of any significant cardiovascular disease, including congestive heart failure (CHF), that would exclude them from enrollment?

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject has any neurologic or medical disease that is likely to progress over the course of the study and/or would interfere with the study.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has severe intellectual disability and multiple neurological conditions (CHF, epilepsy, anoxic brain injury) that are likely to progress and interfere with the study.

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject has any coagulopathy, ventricular anatomic distortion, or previous brain resection.
eligibility_table.justification: No specific mention of coagulopathy, ventricular distortion, or previous brain resection, but the patient's complex medical history raises concerns.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have any documented history of coagulopathy or any previous brain resection procedures?

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject has history, within 12 months prior to consent, of repetitive seizures that cannot be counted with confidence by the subject or competent adult/caregiver.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of seizures that began at age 13 and has had a long period without seizures, but the recent development of seizures indicates potential for repetitive seizures.

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject has history of psychogenic nonepileptic seizures or seizures secondary to illicit drug or alcohol use, neoplasia, active central nervous system infection, demyelinating disease, degenerative neurological disease, progressive CNS disease or metabolic illness.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of epilepsy and anoxic brain injury, which could be considered as secondary causes for seizures, thus meeting this exclusion.

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject has had status epilepticus refractory to benzodiazepines and a second agent within one year prior to consent
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of seizures but no clear indication of status epilepticus refractory to treatment within the last year.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced status epilepticus that was refractory to benzodiazepines and a second agent within the past year?

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject is currently taking neuroleptic medication for behavior control.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is currently taking Valium, which is a benzodiazepine, indicating the use of neuroleptic medication for behavior control.

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject has a clear brain anatomic structural related lesion which distorts the normal anatomy or interferes with CSF fluid flow.
eligibility_table.justification: The MRI shows atrophic changes in the left temporal lobe, but it is unclear if this constitutes a clear structural lesion that distorts anatomy.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the MRI report indicate the presence of a clear brain anatomic structural lesion that distorts normal anatomy or interferes with CSF fluid flow?

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject has required (in addition to low dose stable use of benzodiazepines as part of antiepileptic regimen), in the 3 months prior to consent, benzodiazepine use more than 5 times per month for rescue seizure control. One use is defined as taking up to 3 doses in a 24-hour period.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is on benzodiazepines but there is no clear indication of excessive use for rescue seizure control in the last 3 months.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient used benzodiazepines more than 5 times in the past 3 months for rescue seizure control?

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject is currently implanted with an activated DBS, or RNS device used for treatment of a neurologic or psychiatric condition.
eligibility_table.justification: No information provided about the presence of DBS or RNS devices, making it unclear if this criterion is met.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient currently implanted with an activated deep brain stimulation (DBS) or responsive neurostimulation (RNS) device?

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject currently has VNS and the VNS stimulation parameters are not stable. Stable shall be defined such that the stimulation parameters have not been changed in the last 3 months or the patient/designee is able to report "magnet swipe" during the same time period. The Investigator believes that the continued stable parameters can be maintained through the Primary Evaluation Period.
eligibility_table.justification: There is no mention of VNS device status or stability, leaving uncertainty regarding this exclusion criterion.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Have the VNS stimulation parameters remained unchanged for the last 3 months, or has the patient/designee reported a "magnet swipe" during this same time period?

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject has had more than 10 seizures in one day or more than 200 seizures in one month within last year.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of seizures but the exact number of seizures in the last year is not provided, making it unclear if this criterion is met.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced more than 10 seizures in one day or more than 200 seizures in one month within the last year?

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject has known allergy to citrate, citric acid, valproic acid, divalproex sodium, any components of CT-010, or Depacon®.
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided regarding allergies to the specified substances, so it cannot be determined if this criterion is met.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a known allergy to citrate, citric acid, valproic acid, divalproex sodium, any components of CT-010, or Depacon®?

eligibility_table.criterion: Subject has unstable depression being treated with more than 1 antidepressant medication or has current evidence of or history within the past 2 years of DSM-IV criteria for any major psychiatric disorder including psychosis, major depression, bipolar disorder, and has had a suicide attempt within the previous five years. Also excluded are subjects with a history of prolonged postictal psychosis or psychosis or depression secondary to a discontinued AED.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has severe intellectual disability and epilepsy, but there is no clear evidence of a major psychiatric disorder or prolonged postictal psychosis in the provided history.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced any major psychiatric disorder, including psychosis or major depression, or had a suicide attempt within the past five years?

eligibility_table.criterion: In the opinion of the Investigator, the subject has a clinically significant or unstable medical condition (e.g., uncontrolled diabetes or CHF) or a progressive CNS disease that would limit the subject's entry into the study.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has congestive heart failure (CHF) and severe intellectual disability, which are considered unstable medical conditions that would limit entry into the study.
